next_step_summary: PR #246 extends the populated provider-independent Question Engine inventory with the recurring pre-signing early-exit and replacement-tenant mechanism. The bounded slice keeps continuing rent liability, replacement route, landlord approval standard, assignment/subletting interaction, and release/financial consequences as separate contract-fact questions. It adds no conditional trigger runtime, evidence-target layer, statutory/case-law runtime, post-dispute mode, LLM/provider integration, UI, OCR, Android, serverless, storage, dependencies, permissions, or network access. The next bounded inventory slice is financial sanctions and overlap.
